# Piano Reveries and Phantasies – David Rivera

> Piano Reveries and Phantasies (2015) is a piano-led album by David Rivera, American composer. Free printable piano scores with chords are on Lackadaisical Perfection.

## Album
- [Piano Reveries and Phantasies](https://pianoreveries.com/): the album page, with tracks and listen links.

## Tracks
1. Leaf On a Journey Through Time
2. A Pondering Spider Weaves

7. Dance of the Ant

9. Delicious Sunset
10. Om Provisation
11. Enchanted Forest
12. First Light
13. Thoughts of the Flying Dandelion
14. Sixteenhundred Eighty Five
15. Whispering Petals Stir
16. Graceful Hummingbird
17. Lake of Golden Wisdom
18. Little Waterfall Tickled Pink
19. Mellifluous Swan
20. Scrumptious Morning Strawberry
21. Hop of the Happy Lizard
22. Sensitive Butterfly Effect
